objective: Implement conflict safe migration file publication and conservative source cleanup helpers.
scope: Work only in /workspace/work/holyagent-034-core. Own new files packages/core/src/state/migration-files.ts and packages/core/tests/migration-files.test.ts. Do not edit tree.ts, journal/index/runner files or existing regression tests. Read the completed migration journal types and index helper contract.

Implement publishMigrationFiles({ root, files, authorize }) over typed journal file postimages. root is the caller-trusted canonical target Git worktree root; paths are canonical relative Git paths. For each file, existing expected postimage/mode is an idempotent no-op. Unexpected existing content, deletion of a preexisting owned path, a symlink or changed parent must fail without overwrite. For an originally absent path, publish exact validated bytes atomically without replacing a file created by another writer. Reuse portable Core state helpers and choose a safe no-clobber primitive. Recheck authority before new writes, preserve file data/mode, and leave recoverable partial publication on interruption.

Implement cleanupMigrationSources({ root, source, authorize, ...optionalTrustedIndexCheck }) conservatively. Remove only still-matching owned untracked legacy source files after the caller verifies the target is fully published. Retain tracked source files or changed versions instead of discarding staged/unstaged data; return retained/conflict information. Missing already-cleaned paths are idempotent. Caller controls any legitimate untracking policy later. No guessed git restore/reset and no writes outside canonical roots.

Use Effect, tagged errors, strict decoded persisted boundaries and safe symlink/parent/root checks. Do not claim OS filesystem isolation. Windows UID/mode behavior must not be assumed POSIX; portable behavior should remain viable and platform limitations explicit. No blanket confirmations or new dependencies.

Add actual temporary filesystem tests for normal creation, duplicate retry, existing conflicting bytes, user-created destination after preparation, symlink target/parent, path escape, tracked source retention, modified source retention, safe matching untracked cleanup and interrupted/retried publication. No actual shared state or user files.

Coordinate callback shape with /root/migration_runner_module when it exists. No whole-worktree gates during peer edits; isolated tests allowed, record exact results. Save /workspace/work/034/migration-files-module-report.json, .diff and API contract. Finish actual helper code, not another risk/options handoff.
